resources.string: You need your own account and an original copy of the game. You sign in on the official website, in your browser. HyPocket never asks for your password.
Sign-in is not available yet. HyPocket is waiting for official access from Hypixel Studios.
Open the sign-in page and enter this code:
This account does not own the game.
The game license could not be checked yet.
The code expired. Please try again.
The account service returned an error.
Could not connect. Check your internet connection.
Sign in with an account that owns the game to download and play.
Downloading the game is not available yet.
This device is not supported. HyPocket needs an ARM64 processor.
The game engine is not ready yet.
Unofficial project, not affiliated with Hypixel Studios.
Runs a small x86-64 test program through the Box64 translator and compares it with the same work done natively. It does not use any game files.
Passed: the translated program gave the correct result.
Wrong result: the translated program finished, but its result is different.
Failed: the translated program did not finish correctly.
Timed out: the translated program took too long.
Blocked: Android stopped the translator because it used a system call apps are not allowed to use.
The translator is not available on this device.
Runs a small x86-64 OpenGL ES test program through the translator. It draws a triangle off screen with your phone\'s GPU and checks the colors. It does not use any game files.
Passed: the triangle was drawn with the right colors.
Wrong result: the drawing finished, but the colors are wrong.
Failed: the graphics server did not start.
Drawn correctly, but the desktop OpenGL version is below the 4.1 the game needs.
Shows an animated scene drawn by an x86-64 test program with your phone\'s GPU, using desktop OpenGL 4.1. It runs for 15 seconds and does not use any game files.
Done: the scene was drawn and shown.
Drawn by the test program (can be above the screen\'s refresh rate): %1$.1f fps
Per frame: draw %1$.1f ms, copy %2$.1f ms
